name: GeneTech Knowledge Engine
description: Autonomous Cross-Domain Discovery Network — 30 站点学术知识图谱，27.6 万唯一 DOI，28,001 引用边，36,107 KG 节点。提供混合检索、引用分析、跨域连接发现、可证伪假设生成。

skills.name: Hybrid Search (BM25 + Vector)
skills.description: 混合检索 294,330 学术实体，返回带证据的 top-K 结果
examples: find papers on neuromorphic computing in low-altitude robotics

skills.name: Cross-Domain Bridge Discovery
skills.description: 发现 140 个跨站引用缺口对，Swanson LBD 式连接生成
examples: what bridges exist between quantum-materials and brain-science

skills.name: Falsifiable Hypothesis Generation
skills.description: 生成带证伪条件/证据要求/验证计划的可证伪假设卡
examples: generate 5 testable hypotheses about exo-science and tcm-tools

skills.name: Claim-Level Evidence Extraction
skills.description: 从论文摘要抽取带立场标记的原子命题与证据链
examples: extract claims and evidence from entity HYP-20261016-0001

skills.name: Citation Gap Analysis
skills.description: 分析 870 个站对中 140 个零引用对，定位研究空白
examples: show zero-citation pairs between agritech and life-science

skills.name: Verification Loop
skills.description: 假设→证据→验证→更新的闭环工作流
examples: run verification loop on hypothesis HYP-20261016-0001
